summary: Frontend-only re-test after onboarding readability fix and ingredient/dish icon photo swap. All 5 requested checks PASSED. Onboarding renders Philadelphia skyline as ImageBackground (top half, ~0-360px), a dark rgba(2,20,24,0.55) overlay covers the whole screen, and the content stack (icons/title/subtitle/input/Start Cooking button) sits in the darker lower half (input at y=665, button at y=732 in a 844px viewport) with white shadowed title clearly readable against the dark background. Player creation via testID create-player-button successfully navigates to home-screen. water_ice serve screen renders with tray-rootbeer (root beer photo) and does not crash. happy_cakes serve tray shows tray-apple_pie and does NOT show tray-chocolate_sauce (options: pb_cake, chocolate_cake, butterscotch_cake, mini_pie, sprinkles, apple_pie). Level map renders all 12 levels (level-1 through level-12) with photo/SVG dish preview icons and no crashes.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'textShadow' shorthand. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:314-316, 324-326, 411-413
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Emitted from shared shadow tokens applied across screens.
React Native Web deprecation warning: Image style.resizeMode is deprecated, use props.resizeMode. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx styles.onboardBgImg / styles.bgImg (lines 285, 302)

action_items: (Optional cleanup, non-blocking) Migrate textShadow*/shadow*/resizeMode style props to the newer RN Web equivalents (textShadow shorthand, boxShadow, resizeMode prop on Image) to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding fix is well implemented: ImageBackground + absolute-fill dark overlay + flex-end content stack + white text with textShadow. Content is safely below the bright skyline region.

IngredientIcon/DishIcon correctly return PhotoIngredient/SVG components for the new ids (rootbeer, apple_pie, cheese_sauce, pb_cake, chocolate_cake, butterscotch_cake, mini_pie, sprinkles, american_hoagie, italian_hoagie, tomato_pie, seasoned_fries, scrapple_ec) without breaking the emoji fallback path.
happy_cakes.topping_options in /app/frontend/src/constants/dishes.ts correctly lists only ['apple_pie']; chocolate_sauce is no longer offered as a happy_cakes topping.
seed_data_creation: Created one anonymous player named 'TestChef' via onboarding to reach downstream screens (home, level-map, serve). No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding screen uses ImageBackground(assets/philly_skyline.jpg) + absolute-fill dark overlay + justifyContent flex-end. To force onboarding, clear localStorage in the web preview then reload. Serve routes are reachable directly via /serve?dishId=<id>&level=<n>. Deprecation warnings from RN Web (textShadow*/shadow*/resizeMode) are noisy but non-blocking.
rca_of_issue: N/A - regression checks only; all reported behaviors verified as fixed.
